segments.sn35.101:1.1: “Yaṃ [yampi (pī. ka.)], bhikkhave, na tumhākaṃ, taṃ pajahatha.
segments.sn35.101:1.2: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn35.101:1.6: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn35.101:1.9: Te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti.
segments.sn35.101:1.12: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn35.101:1.15: So vo pahīno hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn35.101:1.16: Yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi na tumhākaṃ.
segments.sn35.101:1.18: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati. Sotaṃ na tumhākaṃ. Taṃ pajahatha. Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati. Saddā na tumhākaṃ. Te pajahatha. Te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti. Sotaviññāṇaṃ na tumhākaṃ. Taṃ pajahatha. Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati. Sotasamphasso na tumhākaṃ. Taṃ pajahatha. So vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissati. Yampidaṃ sotasamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi na tumhākaṃ. Taṃ pajahatha. Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati. Ghānaṃ na tumhākaṃ. Taṃ pajahatha. Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati. Gandhā na tumhākaṃ. Te pajahatha. Te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti. Ghānaviññāṇaṃ na tumhākaṃ. Taṃ pajahatha. Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati. Ghānasamphasso na tumhākaṃ. Taṃ pajahatha. So vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissati. Yampidaṃ ghānasamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi na tumhākaṃ. Taṃ pajahatha. Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn35.101:2.3: Sā vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn35.101:2.6: Te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti.
segments.sn35.101:2.9: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn35.101:2.12: So vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissati. Yampidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi na tumhākaṃ. Taṃ pajahatha. Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati … pe …. Mano na tumhākaṃ. Taṃ pajahatha. So vo pahīno hitāya sukhāya bhavissati. Dhammā na tumhākaṃ. Te pajahatha.
segments.sn35.101:3.6: Te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti.
segments.sn35.101:3.9: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn35.101:3.12: So vo pahīno hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn35.101:3.13: Yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi na tumhākaṃ.
segments.sn35.101:3.15: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn35.101:4.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, yaṃ imasmiṃ jetavane tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ taṃ jano hareyya vā ḍaheyya vā yathāpaccayaṃ vā kareyya, api nu tumhākaṃ evamassa –
segments.sn35.101:4.3: ‘amhe jano harati vā ḍahati vā yathāpaccayaṃ vā karotī’”ti?
segments.sn35.101:7.1: “Na hi no etaṃ, bhante, attā vā attaniyaṃ vā”ti.
segments.sn35.101:8.3: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn35.101:8.4: Rūpā na tumhākaṃ … cakkhuviññāṇaṃ … cakkhusamphasso … pe … yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi na tumhākaṃ.
segments.sn35.101:8.9: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissatī”ti.

lines: 101-102. Aṭṭhamaṃ upamāya parivāretvā kathite bujjhanakānaṃ, navamaṃ suddhikavaseneva bujjhanakānaṃ ajjhāsayavasena vuttaṃ.
Attho pana ubhayatthāpi khandhiyavagge vuttanayeneva veditabbo.
